title: Semiconductor Market Doubling in 2026 - Last Issue
gist: Per WSTS, the semiconductor market hit $481B in 3Q 2026, up 27% QoQ and a record 129% YoY, with 2026 certain to at least double 2025, driven by AI and memory (SK Hynix +49%, Kioxia +40% QoQ). 4Q guidance is mixed (AMD, MediaTek strong; Intel, Skyworks down on weak PCs/phones); Semiconductor Intelligence forecasts 60% growth in 2027 (80% high case) in Bill Jewell's final newsletter.

insights.claim: According to WSTS, the global semiconductor market was $481 billion in 3Q 2026, up 27% from 2Q 2026 and 129% from 3Q 2025, the highest year-on-year growth in WSTS history.
insights.speaker: Bill Jewell
insights.so_what: Confirms an unprecedented demand/price surge; benchmark for evaluating chip company results.
insights.quote: The 3Q 2026 year-to-year growth was the highest in WSTS history, exceeding 110% growth in 2Q 2026 versus 2Q 2025.
insights.locator: The global semiconductor market was $481 billion

insights.claim: Through the first three quarters of 2026 the semiconductor market is up 104% year on year, so full-year 2026 is certain to at least double 2025, with recent forecasts clustered at 110% to 112%.
insights.speaker: Bill Jewell
insights.so_what: Growth this extreme has not occurred since the industry's earliest days, signalling either a structural shift or a cycle peak.
insights.quote: This extraordinary growth has not been seen since the early days of the industry over sixty years ago.
insights.locator: In the first three quarters of 2026

insights.claim: Nvidia's 3Q 2026 revenue rose 20% quarter on quarter, and Nvidia guided for growth moderating to 12% in 4Q 2026.
insights.speaker: Bill Jewell
insights.so_what: Deceleration in Nvidia's sequential growth is a key watch item for AI-chip momentum.
insights.locator: AI continued to dominate semiconductor market growth.

insights.claim: Samsung Semiconductor, SK Hynix, Micron Technology, Kioxia and Sandisk all cited AI as their primary growth driver and collectively grew revenue 36% quarter on quarter in 3Q 2026, with SK Hynix up 49% and Kioxia up 40%.
insights.speaker: Bill Jewell
insights.so_what: Memory makers are the highest-beta beneficiaries of AI demand.
insights.quote: The highest growth was from memory companies SK Hynix at 49% and Kioxia at 40%.
insights.locator: AI continued to dominate semiconductor market growth.

insights.claim: All of the top twenty semiconductor suppliers increased revenue in 3Q 2026 versus 2Q 2026.
insights.speaker: Bill Jewell
insights.so_what: Breadth of growth in 3Q contrasts with the mixed 4Q outlook.
insights.locator: AI continued to dominate semiconductor market growth.

insights.claim: Of fourteen top semiconductor companies giving 4Q 2026 guidance, ten expect revenue gains and four expect declines, with AMD guiding +27% on data center demand and MediaTek +29% on AI accelerator demand.
insights.speaker: Bill Jewell
insights.so_what: AI/data-center exposure is the dividing line between growers and decliners.
insights.locator: The revenue guidance for 4Q 2026 versus 3Q 2026 is mixed.

insights.claim: Intel guided for a 6.1% 4Q 2026 revenue drop on a weak PC market and Skyworks for a 6.7% decline on a weak smartphone market, showing consumer-device segments lagging AI-driven segments.
insights.speaker: Bill Jewell
insights.so_what: Consumer-exposed chipmakers are underperforming; watch for spillover from high memory costs into device demand.
insights.locator: Intel guided for a 6.1% revenue drop

insights.claim: Skyworks entered the top twenty semiconductor suppliers after completing its merger with Qorvo, pushing Onsemi out of the top twenty.
insights.speaker: Bill Jewell
insights.so_what: Industry consolidation in RF reshapes the supplier rankings.
insights.locator: Skyworks is a new entry to the top twenty

insights.claim: Texas Instruments and Infineon guided 4Q 2026 revenue down 0.1% and 2.3% respectively, but both said these declines were better than typical fourth-quarter seasonality.
insights.speaker: Bill Jewell
insights.so_what: Analog/industrial names showing better-than-seasonal trends may indicate a recovery in non-AI segments.
insights.locator: Texas Instruments and Infineon Technologies both guided

insights.claim: Forecasts for 2027 semiconductor market growth range widely from RCD Advisors' 23% to Semiconductor Intelligence's 60% base case, with a Semiconductor Intelligence high-end scenario of 80%.
insights.speaker: Bill Jewell
insights.so_what: Wide forecast dispersion signals high uncertainty in the 2027 cycle path; position for volatility.
insights.quote: Forecasts for 2027 vary widely, from RCD Advisors’ 23% to our Semiconductor Intelligence’s 60%.
insights.locator: In the first three quarters of 2026

insights.claim: Semiconductor Intelligence expects quarter-to-quarter growth to slow in 2027 but momentum alone to still drive significant annual growth.
insights.speaker: Bill Jewell
insights.so_what: Year-on-year comps will look strong even as sequential growth decelerates — watch QoQ trends for the inflection.
insights.quote: We believe quarter-to-quarter growth rates will slow down in 2027, but momentum will drive significant growth.
insights.locator: In the first three quarters of 2026
